desc: Ideation: reduce to prefix counting; all zero-containing positive integers are beautiful; count no-zero beautiful numbers with digit DP tracking digit sum and capped prime exponents of the digit product.

Implement and test the complete solution in the starter code using the chosen approach: count_no_zero(n) by length/prefix formula; count_no_zero_beautiful(n) by memoized digit DP over (pos, tight, sum, capped e2, e3, e5, e7) with leading zeros allowed only before start and digits 1-9 after start; F(n)=n-count_no_zero(n)+count_no_zero_beautiful(n) with F(0)=0; beautifulNumbers(l,r)=F(r)-F(l-1). Verify with the provided examples, single-digit and zero-containing edge cases, powers of ten, max constraint, and brute force for small n.
